visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a dark grey robe, stands with her back to the camera in a room with a vaulted wooden ceiling. She drops the robe to the floor, revealing a white one-piece swimsuit, while standing in front of a stone bathtub. (2) The woman sits on the edge of the stone tub, smiling brightly at the camera while kicking her legs in the clear water. The setting is bright with natural light from a large window showing green foliage. (3) Several quick cuts show the woman in different poses around the tub: sitting inside, leaning on the edge, and looking pensively toward the camera. (4) A first-person perspective shot follows, looking down at long legs immersed in a white bathtub filled with milky white water. (5) The camera pans across various sections of a modern living space: a minimalist room with a wooden floor and a projector, a grey sofa, a large bed on a raised wooden platform, and a compact kitchen area with grey cabinetry and a small toaster oven. (6) Further panning reveals a bathroom with a grey tiled wall, a modern toilet, a round mirror with backlight, and a white freestanding tub. Finally, the camera shows a low wooden table with floor chairs on a woven mat, followed by a return to the large stone tub scene.
